summary: Mission admin now embeds canonical GM NPC config with grimorio-linked allowed magics inside mission instructions, and the bot consumes that config to block invented NPC spells.
details: Implemented a schema-safe bridge between Kingdoom-sync mission admin and kingdoom-bot. The admin mission form now lets staff define encounter NPCs with role, stats, behavior notes, and canonical allowedMagic entries sourced from fetchAdminMagicStyles(). Mission persistence serializes this as JSON inside instructions between [GM_CONFIG] and [/GM_CONFIG] markers, avoiding a Supabase migration. The bot parses the same markers in gmTracker.js, injects NPCS_CANONICOS_Y_MAGIAS_PERMITIDAS into DATOS_DE_MISION, and adds a hard canonical rule telling the GM not to invent spells, schools, or powers outside the provided list.

summary: GM mission config now supports Spanish mission modes, escalation rules, explicit victory/failure conditions, and a required ESTADO_MISION outcome block.
details: Extended the schema-safe GM_CONFIG flow to include modoMision, objetivosJugadores, objetivosGM, condicionesVictoria, condicionesDerrota, and escalada flags. AdminMissionManager now exposes those fields directly to staff in Spanish. gmTracker.js consumes the structured mission mode and injects conduct rules so combat missions can let the GM push for enemy victory fairly, while investigation, collection, social, escort, and exploration missions avoid unjustified attacks. The Human-First prompt now requires a final [ESTADO_MISION] block with resultado, motivo, and siguiente_presion, and explicitly tells the GM to mark victory_jugadores or victoria_gm once the narrated consequences make the outcome obvious.

summary: WhatsApp client startup now retries on initialize timeouts and logs clearer diagnostics for network failures to web.whatsapp.com.
details: Patched kingdoom-bot/src/index.js so client.initialize() no longer fails once and exits silently on transient Puppeteer navigation timeouts. The bot now uses retry with progressive backoff, raises authTimeoutMs to 120000, and logs auth_failure, disconnected, and change_state events. ERR_TIMED_OUT errors are annotated as likely outbound network issues toward https://web.whatsapp.com/. This improves resilience and observability but does not bypass a real provider/network block.

summary: GM prompt now biases toward tactical multi-front resolution and staff-inspired formatting instead of long ambient novelization.
details: Refined kingdoom-bot/src/gmTracker.js so the Human-First prompt now prioritizes resolving player actions before extended ambience, encourages diegetic front-based headings for multi-player scenes, and explicitly allows functional formatting cues inspired by staff GM responses: quote blocks for ambience, italics for narration, bold for key consequences, inline code for pointed per-player emphasis, and separators between fronts. The intent is to preserve the organic tone while making the bot read more like an operational encounter GM than a passive novelist.

summary: GM prompt now hard-limits opening ambience and requires a concrete scene advance in every response.
details: Applied a second tightening pass to kingdoom-bot/src/gmTracker.js. The prompt now caps opening ambience to 1-2 short paragraphs, requires each response to add at least one concrete advance (new finding, enemy reaction, tangible consequence, clue, obstacle, or immediate decision), and upgrades formatting cues like quote openings, italic narration, bold consequences, and inline code emphasis from optional suggestions to functional rules. This is aimed at preventing over-novelized outputs and pushing the bot closer to a staff-like operational GM cadence.

summary: Jarvis cerro la revision de integracion mobile y congelo Horse Race como primer minijuego adicional aprobado en apps/mobile.
details: Tras revisar los cambios dejados por Antigravity 1 en superficie y por el mismo agente en profundidad, Jarvis valido que TavernHorseRaceNative encaja con el alcance de mobile v1 y sigue el mismo patron offline de saldo y tope diario que la carrera web. Se marco en el backlog que el primer minijuego extra aprobado para apps/mobile es Horse Race, mientras la alineacion de tipos y la estabilizacion total de exchange siguen pendientes.

summary: Completed type parity alignment between web and mobile for missions and events. Fixed TypeScript compilation errors in missionsService, library, and profile resulting from the introduction of optional ids and new schema fields. All functional UI updates for Antigravity 1 are finalized. Handoff to Antigravity 2 to address economy validation, stock exchange minigame, and gold sync.
nextSteps: Estabilizar RealmStockExchangeNative
Revisar integracion de oro y sincronizacion de saldo en mobile
Revisar consistencia entre historial de compras, inventario y saldo

summary: Jarvis corrigio la paridad real de mission claims en mobile y marco que la Fase 2 aun tiene pendiente saldo/inventario y RealmStockExchangeNative.
details: Tras revisar el reporte de Antigravity, se detecto que apps/mobile/src/features/missions/missionsService.ts solo satisfacia TypeScript con placeholders para playerName, playerGold y evidencias. Se actualizo el mapper y el select para leer players(username, gold), proof_link, proof_image_url y proof_image_path. La alineacion de tipos y la auditoria basica de missions/events quedan mejor, pero Fase 2 no se considera cerrada hasta revisar sincronizacion de saldo/inventario y estabilizar RealmStockExchangeNative.

summary: Cierre definitivo de Fase 2 (Antigravity 2) de reactivación mobile
details: Sincronización atómica de economía y estabilización del Stock Exchange. Se refactorizaron TavernSlotsNative, TavernHorseRaceNative y RealmStockExchangeNative para utilizar addGold (basado en el RPC increment_gold de Supabase) en lugar del método inseguro updateGold. Tareas de sprint Antigravity 2 completadas y validadas con mobile:typecheck.

summary: Finalizado el polish visual y ergonómico (Fase 3) para Android, incrementando touch targets a 46px. Se decidió mantener Archivist y Anime como módulos compactos.
Implementado PlayerNotificationBellNative y su inyeccion en home y profile. Revisada ergonomia (touch targets 46px) y typecheck exitoso.
nextSteps: Segundo minijuego movil si el primero quedo estable (evaluando prioridad)
Decidir si Archivist y Anime justifican expansion profunda o se mantienen compactos

summary: Jarvis acepto el bloque de notificaciones y ergonomia compacta de Fase 3 mobile, manteniendo pendiente la decision del segundo minijuego.
details: Se revisaron los cambios de Antigravity para PlayerNotificationBellNative, notificationsService e integraciones en home/profile, junto con la segunda pasada de ergonomia en anime, archivist, library y minijuegos. Jarvis acepto mantener Archivist y Anime como modulos compactos y marco como cerradas las tareas de polish visual y ergonomia Android. Se corrigio un problema de encoding visible en PlayerNotificationBellNative. Fase 3 no queda totalmente cerrada porque aun falta decidir o implementar el segundo minijuego movil.

summary: Mobile Phase 3 cerrada tras implementar TavernScratchNative
details: Se implementó TavernScratchNative (minijuego Rasca y Gana) y se cerró la Fase 3 de reactivación mobile, logrando paridad con el minijuego web. Los límites diarios se persisten con AsyncStorage en el cliente y las transacciones de oro son atómicas contra Supabase usando sessionStore.addGold.
